_doc: Per-car audit of the Mercedes CLEAN set (82 triaged clean, 2 exact duplicates dropped). Rubric: CLAUDE.md 'Per-car audit rubric'. Written incrementally -- the container is ephemeral and the /tmp Mercedes scratch was already lost once; only the repo copy survived.

dedd8f64a05d4d769d352ddcac034d25.name: Mercedes-Benz C-Class MK3 W204 2007-2014
dedd8f64a05d4d769d352ddcac034d25.note: tyres missing -- bare black hubs in the arches; stray white geometry floating above the roof in every view; and the RECOLOUR DID NOT LAND, body renders red under --colour silver. cov=0.061

63c20a79bbb84d60a466b578561f29a1.name: Mercedes-Benz ML (W163) 1997-2005
63c20a79bbb84d60a466b578561f29a1.note: ON ITS SIDE -- the front views show the undercarriage. geom_audit lists 'on-side' among the cases it detects, and it is still not wired into gpu_wave. Recolour also did not land. cov=0.061

a73c924778de4d66ae45a7880ab8943e.name: Mercedes Benz SLR McLaren (Bull)
a73c924778de4d66ae45a7880ab8943e.note: geometry reads as SLR McLaren -- chrome multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent across views, shut lines defined. But the RECOLOUR DID NOT LAND: renders its own black under forced silver. cov=0.077. Low-poly at 66k faces, and gloss black hides softness, so re-check if it is ever recoloured light. Ships single-neutral black

1480dab3f0c74dc0a262154ec508e7e0.name: Mercedes Benz G-class AMG Brabus Model
1480dab3f0c74dc0a262154ec508e7e0.note: out of scope AND no recolour -- Brabus aftermarket widebody with Brabus badging, not the stock G-Class a reg decodes to. Renders white under forced silver. cov=0.082

55df50faff8e4918b47a00c6e013d37b.name: Mercedes-Benz Vito MK1 (W638) 1996-2003
55df50faff8e4918b47a00c6e013d37b.note: wheels sunk inside the body -- the arches show only small dark cylinders and the van sits on the floor with no visible tyres. Recolour also did not land, renders white. cov=0.099

6bd804f3f61a4a5e9dcddddab42cf0f9.name: Mercedes- Benz AMG GLC 63s 4MATIC+
6bd804f3f61a4a5e9dcddddab42cf0f9.note: AMG GLC 63s; 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, Panamericana grille crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined, clean reflections. cov=0.109 sits just above the failure band and silver appears to have landed -- the stamp decides

6df2a99b1dbc4b5b8baaf7accf18390f.name: 2012 Mercedes Benz Gl350
6df2a99b1dbc4b5b8baaf7accf18390f.note: GL350; multi-spoke wheels consistent, grille crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. BUT renders pure white at cov=0.114, so the respray likely did not land -- the low-coverage band is a gradient, not a cliff at 0.10

f74b3803425248799902579e10027864.name: Mercedes Benz GL 350 2012
f74b3803425248799902579e10027864.note: same GL350 mesh as 6df2a99b, 59 faces apart (0.06%) -- identical car, wheels and finish, only the render azimuths differ. The 0.5%-plus-nameplate rule was correct on this pair

092ee873e85843c8826fc649c44e9a19.name: Mercedes- Benz GLA35 AMG
092ee873e85843c8826fc649c44e9a19.note: GLA35 AMG; black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent in all four views, Panamericana grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. Renders white at cov=0.113 -- same uncertain band as the GL350, the stamp decides

6ccc813d26ac4dcabdba83c896f4436c.name: Mercedes-Benz B-Klasse MK2 (W246) 2011-2018
6ccc813d26ac4dcabdba83c896f4436c.note: tyres missing -- bare brake discs and suspension exposed, wheels render as flat white plates protruding from the arches. Panel ripple along both flanks. Roof box (taxi sign or sensor) also present

4b028a5eb02b43f184e7b2471ea5c0b9.name: 2004-2010 Mercedes- Benz CLS
4b028a5eb02b43f184e7b2471ea5c0b9.note: fully exploded -- front and rear bumpers detached and floating, wheels are loose white discs, the body levitates on a stack of unattached parts. Not a car, a disassembly

124436c2086d45708608676159a25664.name: Mercedes Benz CLS (C219) 2004-2010
124436c2086d45708608676159a25664.note: same failure as the other CLS -- bumpers detached and lying beside the car, body floating clear of the floor, wheels unattached

97baced3bcf14d9b8c3eedf6233bd4e9.name: Mercedes Benz C43 AMG
97baced3bcf14d9b8c3eedf6233bd4e9.note: otherwise excellent -- black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent, Panamericana grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, premium reflections -- but a marbled crumple artefact sits on the left rear quarter and rear bumper, in the SAME body location across views, so it is surface-bound (texture or normals) and not a reflection. Worth re-sourcing this model

a53e0e45b4b64dc6a65f4eeb016f01f2.name: Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG BRABUS G700 ( The Rocket )
a53e0e45b4b64dc6a65f4eeb016f01f2.note: out of scope -- second Brabus in this set. G700 'The Rocket': widebody, B-badged grille, roof spoiler. Well made, but a reg decodes to a stock G-Class

b721c580738d413c98aeca1f0059a481.name: Mercedes Benz CLE-450
b721c580738d413c98aeca1f0059a481.note: CLE-450, and a recent nameplate worth having. Multi-spoke wheels with gold calipers consistent in all four views, star-pattern grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections

f4a3f2d422af461d8a462674509841f1.name: 2013 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Electric Drive (C197)
f4a3f2d422af461d8a462674509841f1.note: the whole body is covered in shattered triangular facets -- flipped normals or broken smoothing across every panel, worst on the roof, flanks and bonnet. 72k faces. Its near-twin (72,836f) is presumably the same mesh and will fail identically

5455d7c2e4694404a2ee6ecb036ef9e3.name: Mercedes- Benz SLS AMG Electric Drive
5455d7c2e4694404a2ee6ecb036ef9e3.note: same SLS AMG Electric mesh as f4a3f2d4, 4 faces apart -- identical shattered facets across every panel. Both broken; the flagged near-dup pair resolves itself

65a80e8e84c149c18023030733b41a66.name: 2020 Mercedes-Benz EQV
65a80e8e84c149c18023030733b41a66.note: EQV, a nameplate the catalogue does not have. Aero alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. MRC 1920 plate wants blanking

3b25ec59233a4a82a6732b0a1419e553.name: Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG (W464)
3b25ec59233a4a82a6732b0a1419e553.note: STOCK G63 AMG W464 -- the G-Class the two Brabus models could not be. Black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent in all four views, Panamericana grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, spare-wheel cover correct, premium reflections

baf6e4dff35a43febcc6d75c87caa013.name: Mercedes- Benz CLS 63S AMG
baf6e4dff35a43febcc6d75c87caa013.note: CLS 63S AMG C218; dark multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. FLAG: the rear diffuser reads as a dark slab sitting proud of the bumper line -- plausible as the AMG black diffuser but worth a look before it ships

03d647d99f9348328391cd7b1394c7e2.name: 2013 Mercedes-Benz ML250 Bluetec Executive
03d647d99f9348328391cd7b1394c7e2.note: ML250 Bluetec W166; 5-spoke dark alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. Low-poly at 67k so surfaces are simple rather than soft, and a small spiky artefact sits at the rear roof rail

bf1464ad3ffb4f4696aa339f8ab12b07.name: 2010 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG
bf1464ad3ffb4f4696aa339f8ab12b07.note: SLS AMG gullwing; multi-spoke wheels with gold calipers, star-pattern grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. The wheels read dark in two views but that is lighting, not missing geometry -- front34_L and rear34 show full spoke detail

6dd3f12d311d4d1f8a55ce0e1596a442.name: 2004 Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren
6dd3f12d311d4d1f8a55ce0e1596a442.note: excellent SLR McLaren at 744k faces -- turbine wheels consistent in all four views, side vents crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. SUPERSEDES the 66k 'Bull' SLR (a73c9247), which is soft and cannot recolour

05e62ce036554a7eb5cd97b3d2fe0158.name: Mercedes-Benz A-Class W168
05e62ce036554a7eb5cd97b3d2fe0158.note: panel crumpling -- the tailgate and rear quarter carry irregular creasing that does not follow the body form, and the front bumper is crumpled in the rear34 view. Wheels and shut lines are otherwise fine, but the dents read as damaged geometry rather than reflection

96c1c8f27333453db1cde651bc089708.name: 2003 Mercedes-Benz CLK 55 AMG
96c1c8f27333453db1cde651bc089708.note: CLK 55 AMG C209; AMG 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, twin-oval headlight internals crisp, star grille sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean, premium reflections

148cb0c6b73d49c88306151683185181.name: 2023 Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+
148cb0c6b73d49c88306151683185181.note: crumpled front end -- the bonnet leading edge and headlight surround are torn and mangled, clearly visible in the one view that shows the front. Wheels, flanks and shut lines are otherwise clean

ed603ac915a1494f969ed0025ba9d7d0.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class S212 Binz Xtend
ed603ac915a1494f969ed0025ba9d7d0.note: out of scope -- Binz Xtend coachbuilt long-wheelbase conversion (ambulance/hearse body), not a standard E-Class estate. Build quality is good: wheels consistent, grille crisp, shut lines defined. HUMSTER3D plate. A reg decodes to a standard E-Class, not this

6a0ef719f8d74378969b6f6095bd8981.name: Mercedes- Benz GLC-class (X205) F Cell
6a0ef719f8d74378969b6f6095bd8981.note: GLC X205; 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, star grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean, premium reflections. F-Cell is a powertrain variant -- the body is a standard GLC, so it matches on make+model. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

2c21b97ff3dc4fc3b1ef9e4bb0164318.name: Mercedes-Benz AMG GT-R (2017)
2c21b97ff3dc4fc3b1ef9e4bb0164318.note: panel crumpling across the flanks, doors and rear quarters, plus a mangled front splitter. Wheels and grille are fine but 114k faces is not carrying the surfacing on a car this sculptural

106d5ab342744e1a9d9cc473f9d14a5c.name: Mercedes Benz GLS /HU
106d5ab342744e1a9d9cc473f9d14a5c.note: GLS; panels clean, star grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. FLAG: wheels read as black voids in front34 and side while front34_L and rear34 show full chrome multi-spoke with red calipers -- the detailed views prove the geometry exists, so this is lighting, same as the SLS

5ccf8a9bb28e4f3fa509b27b2953e427.name: Mercedes Benz X Class
5ccf8a9bb28e4f3fa509b27b2953e427.note: X-Class double cab; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, star grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, roll bar and bed correct. Also a useful check on the new gate: a pickup is exactly the body type geom_audit's low-top band would flag, which is why that band warns instead of rejecting

86dcc66d18d84561a42d9de681a6011f.name: Mercedes-Benz GLA220 CDi
86dcc66d18d84561a42d9de681a6011f.note: panel crumpling down both flanks and across the rear hatch, with heavy creasing that does not follow the body form. 85k faces

0118a759ff24443b8c15a6ea855a5423.name: Mercedes- Benz SLR Mclaren
0118a759ff24443b8c15a6ea855a5423.note: out of scope -- tuner widebody SLR: roof scoop, huge rear wing, aggressive splitter and diffuser. Well made, but a reg decodes to a stock SLR. Fourth out-of-scope Mercedes

c18392f7273f4d6f85255ae3ff2b389a.name: Mercedes- Benz GLK
c18392f7273f4d6f85255ae3ff2b389a.note: GLK; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, star grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean

e18414e0bed048feb766b3b390784937.name: Mercedes- Benz SLK55 AMG R172
e18414e0bed048feb766b3b390784937.note: fully exploded -- bumpers, doors and body panels all detached and floating around the car, wheels unattached. Same failure as both CLS models

5674a3983cb3493c899dab9d919f80ce.name: 2016 Mercedes-Benz GLA 200
5674a3983cb3493c899dab9d919f80ce.note: panel crumpling down the flanks and doors with the rear hatch creased -- same signature as the GLA220 from a different mesh

36924d74d0494380a3e507d5745d5c14.name: Mercedes- Benz M-class 2011
36924d74d0494380a3e507d5745d5c14.note: UPSIDE DOWN in all four views. Fifth orientation failure today, second in Mercedes -- exactly what the geom_audit gate wired this afternoon auto-rejects

3b5069f7adbd41239671fc4a1a4f77bd.name: Mercedes-Benz ML63 2009
3b5069f7adbd41239671fc4a1a4f77bd.note: tyres missing -- bare white brake discs sit in the arches with no rubber, wheels render as flat plates. Eleventh wheel/tyre failure in this marque

4eb0a08f2c0c4c64b1a3299d5e3954ee.name: Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren
4eb0a08f2c0c4c64b1a3299d5e3954ee.note: SLR McLaren; turbine wheels consistent in all four views, side vents crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. REDUNDANT -- third stock SLR here, and 6dd3f12d at 744k faces is the better one

fa5a62f49dff495fae5223762ca80553.name: Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR
fa5a62f49dff495fae5223762ca80553.note: CLK GTR; excellent -- turbine wheels consistent in all four views, panels clean, shut lines defined, headlight internals sharp, premium reflections. NOTE: a 25-off homologation special, so a UK reg will essentially never decode to it. Road-legal Strassenversion, so not wrong, just very low practical value

fe00234b5af84539ade55c31ca6639e3.name: Mercedes- Benz AMG GT 4- Door Coupe (X290)
fe00234b5af84539ade55c31ca6639e3.note: exploded -- the body floats above a stack of detached bumpers, grilles, sills and wings. Fourth exploded car in this marque

5840d1dc329d430bb85aafee143cc655.name: Mercedes-Benz CL (C216) 2006-2014
5840d1dc329d430bb85aafee143cc655.note: standing VERTICALLY ON END, nose-down, and disassembled with panels scattered. Severe enough that the new geom_audit gate catches it on bounding-box ratio alone -- sixth orientation failure today

842e5669e54b49debebfa7b7b5ae2c15.name: Mercedes-Benz A-Class (W169) 2004-2012
842e5669e54b49debebfa7b7b5ae2c15.note: ON ITS SIDE -- the floor pan faces the camera as a grey slab. Fourth orientation failure in this marque, seventh today

b2810cbb2bde48439bb52d7643cc9485.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class W123 coupe
b2810cbb2bde48439bb52d7643cc9485.note: W123 coupe, a proper classic and a gap the catalogue does not cover. Hubcap wheels consistent in all four views, chrome trim crisp, grille sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking. This is also the car the near-dup rule wrongly paired with the Binz stretch

740b3430e5714dd4a288265b4115ba0d.name: Mercedes- Benz CLS 2022
740b3430e5714dd4a288265b4115ba0d.note: CLS C257 2022; excellent -- multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, diamond grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. The CLS that works: the other two in this set were both exploded

bf41546913a54520a2e38c4b99915d36.name: Mercedes- Benz SL-class (W113) 1963
bf41546913a54520a2e38c4b99915d36.note: SL W113 'Pagoda'; excellent classic -- hubcap wheels consistent in all four views, chrome trim crisp, vertical headlights sharp, pagoda hardtop correct, shut lines defined. A real gap for the catalogue. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

c91f15e9518f4dd2b7574002778cfc28.name: Mercedes-Benz C-Class MK3 (W204) 2007-2014
c91f15e9518f4dd2b7574002778cfc28.note: tyres missing with bare white brake discs in the arches, one wheel detached and floating below the car, body hovering clear of the floor, wipers detached as spikes above the roof

88a61d91431b4414a7e32a936396191c.name: 2013 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT
88a61d91431b4414a7e32a936396191c.note: SLS AMG GT; excellent -- multi-spoke wheels with orange calipers consistent in all four views, side vents crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections. Same C197 generation as bf1464ad, so one of the two will do

b5ed7460384048dcbe89c941d524aff8.name: Mercedes-Benz ML63 2008-2011
b5ed7460384048dcbe89c941d524aff8.note: tyres missing with bare white brake discs in every arch -- the second ML63 to fail this exact way from a different mesh, so it is the source model rather than one bad export

dae8d703b11948799c9f877e8f2858cc.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class (A124) convertible
dae8d703b11948799c9f877e8f2858cc.note: E-Class A124 convertible; alloys consistent in all four views, soft-top correct, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Third classic in this stretch and a segment the catalogue has nothing in. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

06b7a34016a44d3e8e953e5fc68d58ec.name: Mercedes- Benz C-class (S202) estate
06b7a34016a44d3e8e953e5fc68d58ec.note: C-Class S202 estate; alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

9bd7aeb24fa14ab089c941cf67d675ad.name: Mercedes Benz 300 SL
9bd7aeb24fa14ab089c941cf67d675ad.note: 300 SL Roadster; excellent -- chrome crisp throughout, wheels consistent in all four views, red interior clean, shut lines defined, premium finish. The most iconic classic in this wave

5b85f87f175b434288708b83b62c42de.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class (S124)wagon
5b85f87f175b434288708b83b62c42de.note: E-Class S124 wagon; alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Sixth classic. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

97be219788544a2c953ccc04e37b97e8.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class sedan 2010
97be219788544a2c953ccc04e37b97e8.note: E-Class W212 sedan; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. A different generation from the W213 already live, so it adds coverage. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

81b317899e9641d9ac08f0be4fd09fac.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class (Mk2)(W124)
81b317899e9641d9ac08f0be4fd09fac.note: W124 sedan; alloys consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Seventh classic. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

c56dc8fcfc624cf89ba13760f3ad72ae.name: Mercedes- Benz SL-class R107 coupe
c56dc8fcfc624cf89ba13760f3ad72ae.note: SL R107 coupe; chrome crisp, wheels consistent in all four views, grille sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Eighth classic. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

b5d41f9474c94127a7bf99ebef5da574.name: Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG
b5d41f9474c94127a7bf99ebef5da574.note: SLS AMG; multi-spoke wheels consistent, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. REDUNDANT -- third SLS in this set, and 88a61d91 at 340k faces is the best of them

dff3640ff0ff464984e2d7f320794e25.name: Mercedes- Benz E-class (C124) coupe
dff3640ff0ff464984e2d7f320794e25.note: C124 coupe; wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Ninth classic. CONFIRMS the fourth near-dup flag as a FALSE POSITIVE -- a two-door coupe against the W124 four-door sedan, 760 faces apart. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

e98b934960b14077ae7c2e86cbf49064.name: 2011 Mercedes- Benz GL
e98b934960b14077ae7c2e86cbf49064.note: GL X164 at 946k faces; 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. SUPERSEDES the 102k GL350 passed earlier -- same generation, nine times the geometry

609d61e7237f48508fce6405e98c485b.name: Mercedes- Benz S-class 1999
609d61e7237f48508fce6405e98c485b.note: S-Class W140; wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Tenth classic. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

2311177fc828453fb792743b8fe48705.name: Mercedes Benz R-Class W251 2005-2014
2311177fc828453fb792743b8fe48705.note: R-Class W251; 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. Low-poly at 75k but the shapes are simple enough to carry it. A nameplate the catalogue lacks. German plate S-OF 8280 wants blanking

8bf0e8ed024e483b9b9326794d1b2aa6.name: Mercedes- Benz C-class W203 estate
8bf0e8ed024e483b9b9326794d1b2aa6.note: C-Class W203 estate; wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. This is the kept half of the exact-duplicate pair dropped at 743,556 faces. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

517779b60d6d4b778e43403e2765832a.name: 2021 Mercedes-Benz S500
517779b60d6d4b778e43403e2765832a.note: S500 W223; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, premium reflections

03b3e3cc99e6462697a5cbcbb47d17e3.name: Mercedes- Benz S-class (W126) 1979
03b3e3cc99e6462697a5cbcbb47d17e3.note: S-Class W126; wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Eleventh classic. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

61583f5c172f4e25a963e52e1e67c11a.name: Mercedes Benz V Class
61583f5c172f4e25a963e52e1e67c11a.note: wheels are featureless black discs in ALL FOUR views with no spoke geometry anywhere. This is the distinction from the SLS and GLS, which I passed because other angles showed full spoke detail and proved the geometry existed -- here no view does. Body is otherwise clean

efdab8fb67944da6a4449a9da5350134.name: 2012 Mercedes Benz SLS AMG Roadster
efdab8fb67944da6a4449a9da5350134.note: SLS AMG Roadster; multi-spoke wheels with red calipers consistent in all four views, soft-top correct, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined. A different body style from the SLS coupes, so not strictly redundant. Low-poly at 97k but reads well

4ed156b0405e4e529d193ab1ccc11da9.name: 2013 Mercedes-Benz CLS 63 AMG Tuned (W218)
4ed156b0405e4e529d193ab1ccc11da9.note: CLS 63 AMG W218; black multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Title says 'Tuned' but the body reads STOCK -- only wheels and stance differ, which is spec variation, not a widebody kit

1d2494ea90434de984b9dc677461af5a.name: Mercedes- Benz S-class 2003
1d2494ea90434de984b9dc677461af5a.note: S-Class W220; 5-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Fourth S-Class generation here after W126, W140 and W223. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

ff9ba755fc884fb88b5e73c3df1296e1.name: Mercedes- Benz C-class W203 sedan
ff9ba755fc884fb88b5e73c3df1296e1.note: C-Class W203 sedan; wheels consistent in all four views, grille crisp, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

cbad3d3420584ff3b5cd472b869f92d6.name: Mercedes- Benz Ponton 180 W120
cbad3d3420584ff3b5cd472b869f92d6.note: Ponton 180 W120; excellent 1950s classic -- whitewall wheels consistent in all four views, chrome crisp, grille sharp, shut lines defined, panels clean. Twelfth classic and the oldest car in either wave. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

57e93f32bd8a4603bbd3f5fb873728b9.name: Mercedes-Benz AMG-GT 2015 (FBX)
57e93f32bd8a4603bbd3f5fb873728b9.note: Reads instantly as an AMG GT: long bonnet, cab-rear stance and roofline consistent across all four views. Grille lamellae and the internal LED strips in the headlights are sharp in rear34, the multi-spoke silver wheels with red calipers match in every view, and the paint reflections are clean with defined bonnet and door shut lines.  [audited by subagent; 2 of its passes spot-checked and confirmed]

8e0b6498a8a4475e8d4913ddc19f5942.name: Mercedes Benz SL600 R129 Widebody kit
8e0b6498a8a4475e8d4913ddc19f5942.note: Out of scope: this is an aftermarket widebody conversion, not a stock R129 - massively flared arches, a full-width raised rear wing, a bolt-on front splitter and an Indonesian 'B 600 SL' plate. _coverage_finding: TESTED AND CONFIRMED: all 5 entries in the Mercedes clean set with body-material coverage under 0.10 failed to recolour -- every one rendered its own colour under --colour silver (red, white, black, white, white). Coverage under ~10% means the classifier latched onto trim or a badge, not the body paint. 'clean' only requires mats>=1, so these passed triage. Low cov is a PREDICTOR of recolour failure (the GL350 at cov=0.114 also renders white, so the band is a gradient, not a cliff at 0.10) and should gate the colour bake, not just the eye. 5/5 in this set; consistent with Toyota #41 (pink) and #62 (black), which were also split/low-coverage.
_neardup_falsepositive: CONFIRMED as predicted: the 0.5%-plus-nameplate near-dup rule paired the S212 Binz Xtend (887,678f) with a W123 coupe (883,994f). They are completely different vehicles -- a coachbuilt stretch and a 1970s coupe -- so face proximity alone is not identity. The rule flags CANDIDATES for the eye; it must never auto-group. Two of four flagged pairs were real duplicates (GL350, SLS Electric), this one is a false positive, and the C124/W124 pair remains to check.
_neardup_scorecard: Final scorecard on the 0.5%-plus-nameplate near-dup rule across 4 flagged Mercedes pairs: 2 REAL (GL350 59 faces apart, SLS Electric 4 apart) and 2 FALSE POSITIVES (Binz stretch vs W123 coupe; C124 coupe vs W124 sedan). 50% precision. It is a good candidate-finder and must never auto-group -- both false positives would have silently dropped a real car.
_subagent: The final 10 were audited by a subagent given the rubric plus this wave's failure taxonomy. I spot-checked two of its six passes -- AMG GT Black Series (its most debatable call) and AMG-GT 2015 -- and both were right. The Black Series call was the good one: swan-neck wing, Panamericana grille and widened arches are OEM for that model, so it is a road-legal production car a reg decodes to, NOT an aftermarket kit like the four tuner conversions failed elsewhere.
